name: Video clip
purpose: A short generated or supplied video playing full-frame or in a frame, with an optional headline and caption over it.
use_when: a moment that is better seen than drawn: a place, an action, a mood
a cinematic opener or a scene between explainer scenes
avoid_when: anything that needs exact on-screen text inside the footage

video.desc: Path of an mp4/webm clip, e.g. one made by `kinetry media clip`

full.desc: The clip fills the whole frame; text sits on a dark fade at the bottom

framed.desc: The clip in a large rounded frame, text above it

example_beats.say: It's two in the morning, and you're still awake.
